rows.title: End-to-end proof: a germinal products notification for bovine semen, from its start on the origin page to submitted
rows.detail: Nothing proves a second animals set end to end today: every whole journey the tests walk is a live animals one. A germinal products notification starts on its own origin page, with no type question, and runs through its own opening run, which has no Additional details step and keeps each species' total gross weight on Commodity details. This row walks a bovine semen notification through that whole run in the animals test project, checks the overview's task rows once every task is done, checks the review shows the answers given, and checks the confirmation shows the reference. It proves the germinal pages the other germinal rows build, so it lands after them.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a germinal products notification from the germinal products set's start opens the 'Origin of the import' page straight away, with no notification type question before it. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-004; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, -p1-011)

A newly started germinal products notification's review shows 'Certified for' reading 'Germinal products'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

Walking a bovine semen notification that travels by road, 'Save and continue' takes it through 'Origin of the import', 'What are you importing?', 'Main import reason', 'Commodity details', 'Identification details', 'Arrival details', 'Transit countries', 'Transport details', 'Upload documents' and 'Consignment addresses', in that order. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-005; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-022; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

In that walk the total gross weight is entered in the bovine semen species block on 'Commodity details', and 'Save and continue' there opens 'Identification details'. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-022)

In that walk 'Save and continue' on a valid 'Identification details' page opens 'Arrival details'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-006; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-030)

Once every task is done, the notification's overview lists 'Commodity details' then 'Identification details' in its consignment section, and 'Arrival details', 'Transit countries' then 'Transport details' in its transport and arrival section, each reading 'Complete'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-022; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

Before declaring, the walk checks the germinal review page shows each answer it gave, the total gross weight against its species included. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-005; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

Ticking the declaration and continuing submits the notification and opens 'Import notification submitted', a confirmation panel showing 'Your reference number' and the notification's reference, which begins GBN-AG. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062)

The walk runs in the animals test project's germinal products group, under the project's existing browser configuration, with no new test project added. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062; repo:tests repo-tests-p8-152)
openQuestions: Does the germinal products set ask a total gross weight for each species on Commodity details, or one total gross weight for the whole consignment on its own page after Commodity details? Default, followed here: each species' total gross weight is asked in that species' block on Commodity details, no consignment gross weight page is built, and Save and continue on Commodity details goes on to Identification details; the overview has no Total gross weight row. (c-461; c-486 settles the overview row)
rows.notes: Combines three whole-journey slices that share one germinal walk: the germinal start on its origin page (req-2902), the germinal opening run and completed overview (req-2903) and the bovine semen walk to submitted (req-2917). It joins existing row inc-184, whose req-1899 the germinal-products area holds, so the combiner keeps inc-184's id and merges the two drafts. req-2903's statement names a separate Total gross weight step and a Total gross weight overview row; c-486 puts that row out of scope and c-461's default keeps the weight per species on Commodity details, so the criteria follow those and the step order goes from Commodity details to Identification details. 'Labelled Germinal products' is read as the certified-for value every germinal draft carries from creation (req-182, req-2244). A proof row: the pages it walks are built by inc-176 (start and origin), inc-017 (Commodity details with per-species weight), inc-183 (no Additional details), inc-182 (arrival, transit countries, declaration), inc-099 (overview) and inc-105 (review and confirmation).

splitOff.why: It changes the notification view header's Amend action, which is built in the check answers page's template, copy and view model in the animals and plants frontends; theme overview-and-review owns that code and already holds the sibling header requirement req-2364.

Where Save and continue on a complete notification's Consignment addresses leads is set by the live animals journey flow, which sends addresses on to the notification view today; theme journey-foundation owns that flow and the tests repo's animals flows.

It extends the poultry-by-rail journey spec to submission and checks the review's main import reason card; theme commodities-and-reason owns that spec and the import reason pages. The MDM stub's missing species page sits in reference-lists' stub responses, which has already split off and lands first.
